prompt.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a FIVE-FRAME SPRITE SHEET of two Song dynasty travelling companions walking along the road with packs on their backs: one standing pose plus one complete four-frame walk cycle, walking toward the RIGHT of the image. TWO reference images. The FIRST shows the exact character(s) to draw: copy identity, face, hair, clothing colours and carried objects from it. Its camera angle may be from behind or from above; IGNORE that angle. The SECOND reference is a finished walk sheet of a different person: copy ONLY its camera angle (eye-level three-quarter side view, the same as every other figure on the street), its figure scale and its five-cell layout. Do NOT copy that person. Keep: the first has a black hair bun, khaki-brown tunic, a small sage-green cloth backpack, grey trousers and dark shoes; the second wears a wide conical straw hat, a grey-khaki tunic, a wooden-frame backpack tied with cord, dark trousers and dark shoes. They walk SIDE BY SIDE with a small gap between them, both facing right, the hatted man slightly behind on the far side. They are NOT in step: when one has a leg forward the other is passing. Packs stay in the same place on their backs in every cell. For cells 2-5, BOTH figures follow the contact/passing sequence, each with their own legs. Cell 1 = standing at rest, facing right. Cell 2 = contact: front leg forward with heel touching the ground, back leg on its toes, longest stride. Cell 3 = passing: weight on the straight supporting leg under the body, the other leg bent and passing forward, foot just off the ground. Cell 4 = contact with the opposite leg forward, mirror of cell 2. Cell 5 = passing with the opposite leg, mirror of cell 3. The head stays at the same height and the same horizontal position in every walking cell; the body only bobs very slightly. Correct leg anatomy, robe and skirt hems swing with the legs, no extra limbs. Fine ink outlines and muted antique Chinese watercolor exactly matching the first reference, same line weight, same palette, same paper-grain shading. Truly transparent alpha background, no ground shadow, no glow, no grid lines, no numbers, no text. One single horizontal row of 5 equal-width cells, all walking toward the RIGHT of the image, centered in each cell with generous margin so heads, tools, sheaves, umbrellas and feet never touch a cell edge. Identical figure size and identical camera angle in every cell. Make every cell match each other as strictly as possible.
